tools.name: request_info
tools.description: Ask for information or a tool you need but could not find. Any topic. Answers are published only after checking an official or reliable source, usually within days. Returns a request id.

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Check a request by its id.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Search published answers (each has an official or reliable source link, a checked date and a next_review date).

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get one published answer with its source.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the desk whether an answer helped and what was missing or wrong. Short plain text, read by people at check times. This decides what gets added next.

tools.name: get_answers
tools.description: Get up to 25 published answers in one call (ids from search_answers or list_answers). Returns answers plus any missing ids.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Fact-check a number before you state it. Send the value (e.g. 1776 or "$1,776") and either answer_id or a short claim describing it (e.g. "2027 Medicare Part A deductible"). Returns matches / matches_a_listed_figure / matches_previous_value (outdated) / differs / not_covered, the official value, sou

tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What this desk offers, how many answers it has, recent updates, limits and all endpoints.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List published answers. Optional filters: kind, topic, changed_since (YYYY-MM-DD, only answers checked since then: use it to refresh a cache), due (true = answers past their next_review date, possibly out of date).
